events.body: PLAN: cd linux-6.9|./scripts/config --enable-all-symbols|make -j$(nproc)|grep -n "start_kernel" init/main.c|sed -i '/int start_kernel(void)/,/^	{/{s/printk\(KERN_INFO "Booting\)/&\n\tprintk(KERN_INFO "Hello, this is a custom kernel");/}' init/main.c|make -j$(nproc)|mkdir -p usr|make gen_init_cpio|py

PLAN-REVIEW: REVISE 计划中使用了 `--enable-all-symbols` 且多次执行 `make defconfig`，这会导致构建失败或配置被覆盖；`grep -n` 命令用于获取行号但后续未使用且逻辑冗余；`sed` 插入语句的逻辑错误（`&` 指的是匹配行内容，而非插入在 `{` 之后）；`gen_init_cpio` 目标在现代内核中不单独生成二进制文件，必须通过 Makefile 构建集成。请改为：使用 `make defconfig` 作为基础，通过脚本或 `scripts/config` 修改 `.config` 以包含必要的 initramfs/驱动选

[worker workerA r2] {"commands": ["cd /app/linux-6.9 && make defconfig && scripts/config --enable MODULES && make -j$(nproc) && echo 'Insert printk before start_kernel call' && sed -i '/^static void __init start_kernel(void)/a\\\\tprintk(KERN_INFO \"Hello, this is a custom kernel\");' init/main.c && make -j$(nproc)"]}

PLAN: cat /app/data.hex | head -n 100|xxd -r /app/data.hex > /tmp/restored_bin 2>/dev/null || hexdump -e '1/1 "%02x"' /tmp/raw 2>/dev/null; file /tmp/restored_bin; if [ -x /tmp/restored_bin ]; then chmod +x /tmp/restored_bin && /tmp/restored_bin; else arch=$(file /tmp/restored_bin | grep -oE 'ELF 32
[worker workerA r1] {"commands": ["cat /app/data.hex | head -n 100 | xxd -r > /tmp/restored_bin 2>/dev/null || hexdump -e '1/1 \"%02x\"' /tmp/raw 2>/dev/null; file /tmp/restored_bin"]}
